messages:
ana: Quick sync  I uploaded a fresh launch blog draft (highlights + gated deck). Link: https://drive.redwood/infer/launch-v4. Need bench narrative, gated CTA copy, webinar slots, and HS routing by EOD tomorrow.

jamie: I'll do editorial. Headline should be benefit-first. Move one strong stat above the fold.

mike: Bench guidance  include HW, token avg, median latency, and whether KV cache was on. Call out chat vs streaming numbers briefly.

devon: Infra will drop CSV + run IDs by 9am. Webinar tentative slots: Tue 6/30 10am PT or Thu 7/2 6pm PT; let registrants pick.

lisa: Legal quick-pass: no absolutes like "fastest". Use "among the most cost-efficient for latency-sensitive chat workloads". Add privacy link and consent checkbox on forms.

ana: gating plan: 1) Quick trial CTA (no gate) 2) Download deep-dive (gated). Gated CTA draft: "Download the deep-dive benchmark deck  runs, configs, and cost breakdowns."

mike: tiny tweak: "Download the deep-dive benchmark deck  detailed runs, configs, and cost breakdowns."

jamie: Move charts up before "how it works" section. Also add 2-line routing blurb about automatic fallback to compatible variants when capacity constrained.

devon: Routing blurb OK. HS mapping: hidden field `source=blog_launch`, workflow `launch_deck_registrants`, queue `PLG_Launch_Inbound`. I'll confirm in HS export.

publish-bot: Checklist: marketing  done | legal pending | product done | infra pending | hero image missing | publish date unset.

lisa: Ping me after CSV attach for final quick sign-off.

ama: thanks everyone  will post v5 with moved charts, CTA copy, and form spec in ~2hrs.

mike: I'll annotate the demo plan for the webinar (cost compare + routing failover).

devon: I'll handle infra demo and Q&A.

publish-bot: Draft autosaved: /drive/redwood/infer/launch-v4 (link: https://drive.redwood/infer/launch-v4).
